title: combretum subumbellatum
intro: Combretum subumbellatum, commonly known as the White Milk Tree or Milk Bush, is a shrub or small tree belonging to the Combretaceae family, native to southern Africa. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Combretum subumbellatum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its bioactive properties.
